purpose: Presentation copy for production Leader cards. Named faction/Leader concepts are the primary left-column headings; their classification is subordinate. Shared faction procedures remain on faction Reference cards.

sections.name: Run the Gauntlet
sections.text: Capture the Territory at the opponent's end, or force a Last Stand and win the resulting battle.

items.name: Onward
items.text: During your Movement, move one additional Position. This may start a Battle.

items.name: Rally
items.text: Add +1 to your battle total in a battle you initiated.

items.name: Rout
items.descriptor: No Action · End of Aftermath · Win as attacker
items.text: Advance one Position. This movement may initiate a battle.

sections.name: Command
sections.text: The first time each turn you win a battle, gain 1 Command.

items.name: Entrench
items.text: Add +1 to your battle total in a battle you did not initiate.

items.name: Repel
items.descriptor: No Action · Aftermath · Win as defender
items.text: After the opponent's normal retreat, they retreat one additional Position, if able.

items.name: Fortify
items.descriptor: No Action · Aftermath · Win while occupying enemy Territory
items.text: Advance your Front Line by one Territory, if able.

sections.name: Peace Treaty
sections.text: At the start of your turn, if 6 different Proposals are ratified, you win.

sections.name: Cordiality
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · After accepted Terms
sections.text: After the opponent accepts your Terms, draw one card.

sections.name: Peace Treaty
sections.text: At the start of your turn, if 6 different Proposals are ratified, you win.

sections.name: Political Capital
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · After losing following refused Terms
sections.text: When you would lose staked Influence, put up to that many cards from Hand in your Graveyard. Recover 1 staked Influence per card; lose the rest.

sections.name: Controlling Interest
sections.text: If you own the Deeds to every Territory currently in the Gauntlet, you win immediately.

sections.name: Line of Credit
sections.descriptor: No Action · First Deed purchase each turn · Collateral
sections.text: Use one card from Hand or Treasury as collateral. It contributes up to half the purchase cost, rounded down; pay the rest with Capital, then discard the collateral.

sections.name: Capital
sections.text: Capital Limit = Territories you control + total card value in Treasury.

sections.name: Controlling Interest
sections.text: If you own the Deeds to every Territory currently in the Gauntlet, you win immediately.

sections.name: Hostile Takeover
sections.descriptor: 1 Action · Denouement · After winning as attacker
sections.text: While occupying that enemy Territory, buy or buy out its Deed. Treat yourself as occupier for cost. If successful, advance your Front Line by one Territory, if able.

sections.name: Capital
sections.text: Capital Limit = Territories you control + total card value in Treasury.

sections.name: Special Operation
sections.text: When Operation Progress exceeds opposing controlled Territories, complete a prepared Special Operation and pay its Intel cost to win.

sections.name: Fieldcraft
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · Territory effect
sections.text: When a printed Territory effect would affect you, your movement, or a battle involving you, ignore that effect until the end of the turn.

sections.name: Intel
sections.text: Spend Intel on Intelligence features and effects.

sections.name: Operation Progress
sections.text: Increment by 1 each time you complete a normal Mission.

sections.name: Special Operation
sections.text: When Operation Progress exceeds opposing controlled Territories, complete a prepared Special Operation and pay its Intel cost to win.

sections.name: Mission Control
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · After completing a normal Mission
sections.text: Immediately start another eligible Mission from Hand. It cannot complete that turn and cannot be a Special Operation.

sections.name: Intel
sections.text: Spend Intel on Intelligence features and effects.

sections.name: Ritual of Ascension
sections.text: After completing all three Rites, begin the Ritual; initiate and win a battle while all three Ritual cards remain bound.

sections.name: Materia Prima
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · First qualifying sacrifice from Hand
sections.text: Draw one card the first time on your turn that a card from Hand enters your Graveyard for a Rite, Transmutation, or Arcane card effect. During battle, draw after the Aftermath.

sections.name: Ritual of Ascension
sections.text: After completing all three Rites, begin the Ritual; initiate and win a battle while all three Ritual cards remain bound.

sections.name: Guardians of the Circle
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · Battle loss would interrupt Rite or Ritual
sections.text: Put one Arcane card from Hand in your Graveyard whose value is at least 1 plus your completed Rites. If you do, prevent that interruption.

sections.name: Purification
sections.text: If the opponent's normal start-of-turn draw fails because both their Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty, you win immediately.

sections.name: Final Judgment
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · After winning a battle
sections.text: After battle cards are cleared, immediately Purge. Reduce that Purge's Conviction cost by 1, to a minimum of 1.

sections.name: Conviction
sections.text: The first time each turn opposing cards enter the Graveyard during the Aftermath of a battle involving you, gain 1 Conviction.

sections.name: Purification
sections.text: If the opponent's normal start-of-turn draw fails because both their Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty, you win immediately.

sections.name: Relentless Pursuit
sections.descriptor: No Action · Once per turn · After defeating an attacking opponent
sections.text: End their turn, then advance one Position toward their end. If this movement initiates a battle, you are the attacker.

sections.name: Conviction
sections.text: The first time each turn opposing cards enter the Graveyard during the Aftermath of a battle involving you, gain 1 Conviction.
